commits.message:
TenderGuard v0.3 publish snapshot

- README resync to v0.3 (review_type 6-value taxonomy, Evidence
  Quality 5-level, Failure Taxonomy 10-class, AtomicRequirement,
  hard-rule whitelist). Previous README was still v0.1 wording.
- Re-mirror source: refresh code / prompts / config / evaluation
  from the local workspace.
- Exclude tests/, data/source/, data/normalized/, and PDF samples
  from the public blob (sensitive data + tests stay in the
  workspace, not the published snapshot).
- .gitignore declares the same exclusions so any future force-push
  stays consistent.

Bug fix: this commit drops the spurious base64 round-trip. The
Git Data API stores `content` as the literal bytes of the blob
with no decoding layer — encoding=base64 in the tree entry is
silently ignored, so the previous commits ended up with base64
ASCII sitting in place of every text file. This commit uploads
raw UTF-8 bytes.

TenderGuard v0.3 publish snapshot

- README resync to v0.3 (review_type 6-value taxonomy, Evidence
  Quality 5-level, Failure Taxonomy 10-class, AtomicRequirement,
  hard-rule whitelist). Previous README was still v0.1 wording.
- Re-mirror source: refresh code / prompts / config / evaluation
  from the local workspace.
- Exclude tests/ and data/source/ from the public blob
  (per repo policy: sensitive data + tests live in the workspace,
  not the published snapshot).
- .gitignore declares the same exclusions so any future force-push
  stays consistent.

Every blob carries encoding=base64 so GitHub decodes the text
files correctly (fix for the previous base64-as-ASCII bug).

Fix: declare encoding=base64 on every blob

Previous commit stored base64 strings AS-IS, so every text file
on GitHub rendered as base64 garbage. This commit re-uploads
all files with encoding=base64 so GitHub decodes them.

No content changes; same TenderGuard v0.3 source.

Initial commit: TenderGuard v0.3

Evidence-Grounded, Rule-Governed Tender Compliance System.

- 6-layer pipeline (INGEST/EXTRACT/RETRIEVE/VERIFY/REPORT)
- 17 Rule operators + hard-rule whitelist (Rule Engine > LLM)
- 5-tier Evidence Quality + 10-class ReviewReason
- 61 direct-tender CK from Excel with 6 review_type classification
- True multi-page table extraction (5-state machine)
- 17 + 14 regression tests + 60-case evaluation harness
- HTML dashboard with SVG metrics + ASCII state-machine diagrams

Privacy: no real tender PDFs or CK Excel shipped; synth generator included; .gitignore blocks accidental commits of data/source/, *.pdf, output/
